description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order to impose Special Commodity Levy on Peas
reasoning: This gazette notification imposes a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory changes to tax rates on specific commodities (peas) and rescinds a previous order. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa by name, the core content is about legal/regulatory matters - specifically modifying tax regulations and rates under existing legislation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
